'''''Arithmetic  for Parents''''' (Sumizdat, 2007, {{ISBN|9780977985258}}) is a book about [[mathematics education]] aimed at parents and teachers.<ref>{{citation|title=''Arithmetic for Parents: A Book for Grownups about Children's Mathematics''|periodical=MAA Reviews|publisher=[[Mathematical Association of America]]|url=http://www.maa.org/publications/maa-reviews/arithmetic-for-parents-a-book-for-grownups-about-childrens-mathematics|first=Megan R.|last=Bovill|date=April 19, 2007}}.</ref><ref name="cut">{{citation|title=Review of ''Arithmetic for Parents''|website=[[Cut-the-Knot]]|url=http://www.cut-the-knot.org/books/Reviews/ArithmeticForParents.shtml|author=[[Alexander Bogomolny|Bogomolny, Alexander]]}}.</ref>

The author, [[Ron Aharoni]], is a professor of mathematics at the [[Technion – Israel Institute of Technology|Technion]]; he wrote the book based on his experiences teaching [[elementary mathematics]] to Israeli schoolchildren.<ref name="cut"/>
The book was originally written in Hebrew and was translated to English, Portuguese and Dutch.
